newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stock market watchdog to probe announcements.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stock market watchdog to probe announcements.

text.p: South Korea's Securities Supervisory Board said on Thursday it would form special teams to investigate announcements by listed companies that could seriously influence their share prices.
The board said in a statement the teams would begin operation from next Monday.
The statement said "insincere" announcements by listed companies continued, disturbing market order and hurting investors, despite strengthened regulations.

It said the main targets for investigations would include announcements of unproven new technology developments, reversals of earlier announcements and various unfair practices in connection with share buyback plans.
